pathAssistantSteps.info: Closing wire confirmed. Property Asset (AUM) created (Conv 4). Offering goes Active. Broker fully credited.
Deal dropped at any stage. Rejection Reason is required. Broker protection is preserved for future re-engagement.
Prep the LOI, then submit for principal approval. Once approved it is sent to the broker; track every counter and version on the LOI record's Messages tab. On full execution, Legal + IR are notified.
Post-Conversion 1. Confirm the broker Account/Contact and Property are populated, then advance to Under Review to begin the NDA.
One seller selling multiple properties, bundled for a single LOI. Each child deal tracks its own broker protection independently.

Seller issues the first PSA draft; a Contract Review opens automatically. Log every version and counter in the negotiation log. On full execution (Negotiation Status = Executed) the Transaction is created, the 75-task fan-out fires, and Transactions + IR + Due Diligence are notified.
NDA process: Pending then Sent then Signed. Validation blocks advancing to Underwriting until NDA Signed = TRUE.
Capture the 10 key underwriting fields. CoStar + Placer market data auto-populates the Property. Principals review (2 of 3 agree).
